=Library dependences.=

If you want to use odiem whith boundled jndi sun stack, you don't need other libraries.

== Unboundid stack ==

Add lib/unboundid/*unboundid-ldapsdk-se.jar* to your classpath

== Apache stack ==

Add following libraries to your classpath:

  * lib/apache/*jcl-over-slf4j-1.5.10.jar*
  * lib/apache/*ldap-client-api-0.1.jar*
  * lib/apache/*log4j.jar*
  * lib/apache/*shared-all-0.9.18.jar*
  * lib/apache/*slf4j-api-1.5.10.jar*
  * lib/apache/*slf4j-log4j12-1.5.10.jar*

== Novel stack ==

Add following libraries to your classpath:

  * lib/novell/*ldap.jar*
  * lib/novell/*utilities.jar*


== Advanced featured ==

If you want to search on a bean marked as abstract you have to add to your classpath

  * lib/*javassist.jar*
  * lib/*scannotation-1.0.2.jar*
